nodes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (life cover)
nodes.description: Life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for a very small yearly premium, auto-debited from the bank account - especially important for the earning member of a daily-wage family.

nodes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (accident cover)
nodes.description: Accident insurance of Rs 2 lakh (Rs 1 lakh for partial disability) for about Rs 20 a year - the cheapest cover available to a worker who rides or works with tools.
